name: Indigo — Distant Thunder
summary: Wide, calm cinematic pixel-art landscape for a 2D artillery platformer, using a restrained palette of indigo, dusty lilac, slate blue and warm dusty peach. Indigo-violet dusk grades toward a peach horizon, with strong aerial perspective separating distant mountain ranges. Crisp stepped pixel contours, sparse clustered dithering and broad quiet color fields; no soft painted brushwork. Keep mountain peaks in the lower third and leave ample clear sky for readable projectiles. Environmental silhouettes remain small, subdued and lower-contrast than gameplay terrain. No tanks, weapons, people, letters, signage or UI. Every landscape repeats seamlessly left to right, with matching edge heights, colors and texture phases; no framing borders or abrupt vertical cutoffs.
